faq.title: Got Questions?
faq.item1Question: How can I book a tour?
faq.item1Answer: You can book directly from our website by clicking the booking button on each tour, or by contacting us by phone or email. We'll guide you through the entire process.
faq.item2Answer: Yes, all our tours include round-trip transportation from your hotel in Cusco, as well as any internal transfers needed during the excursion.
faq.item3Question: Can I cancel or modify my booking?
faq.item3Answer: You can cancel or modify your booking up to 48 hours before the tour at no additional cost. Check our terms for more details.
faq.item4Question: What should I bring on the tour?
faq.item4Answer: We recommend bringing comfortable clothes, walking shoes, sunscreen, a hat, camera and water. Specific gear varies depending on the tour.
faq.item5Question: Are the tours suitable for children?
faq.item5Answer: Yes, we have family tours designed for all ages. Please provide children's ages when booking to customize the experience.
faq.item6Question: What languages do the guides speak?
faq.item6Answer: Our guides are bilingual: they speak Spanish and English. We also have Portuguese-speaking guides subject to availability.
